svg.text: The final artifact is assembled from prior worksheet evidence, not invented at the end.

g.text: System block
Alex current operating rule
Buyer / account anchor
Established regional home-service companies where the Lead-Ready Website System plausibly fits
a visible or buyer-confirmed lead-generation or site-conversion problem.
Pursuable / disqualify
Require plausible buyer/problem fit, solution fit, stakeholder path, economic plausibility, and no
hard disqualifier. Timing strengthens priority but does not prove budget or intent.
Evidence / AI
Separate fact, observation, inference, buyer-confirmed commercial fact, unknown, and decision.
AI may suggest; source verification controls consequential claims.
Qualification / stakeholder
Cheap qualification before deep research. Scores only as local heuristics. Choose roles from problem
ownership and purchase context; verify identity and contact route separately.
Channel portfolio
Qualified direct email for controlled access and feedback; Jordan relationship path for trust/context;
public proof supports verification; marketplaces remain optional, not foundational.
Research / Contact Ready
Retain fact, source, date, inference, unknown, stakeholder, and decision. Current direct cohort requires
verified timing/change evidence or substantially stronger problem evidence before contact.
Follow-up / nurture / stop
Finite local follow-up; classify replies as evidence; nurture only with a real future reason or window;
suppress and stop where required.
Opportunity gate
Need/change + relevant stakeholder + service fit + economic plausibility + timing/decision condition +
real next sales step. Positive reply alone does not pass.
Measurement / economics
Use explicit stage denominators and rolling internal cohorts. Track owner time, cash, lag, opportunities,
mature wins, contribution, concentration, and confidence.
Current constraint / next test
Test whether tighter reason-now evidence improves downstream direct-access movement; keep stakeholder
quality as a competing hypothesis; stop forcing the source if legitimate candidates cannot be produced.

svg.text: Fictional worked example. The operating system preserves uncertainty and changes only when new evidence justifies it.
